source: the criteria block under 'Completeness contract' in each reference

criteria.text: 20 candidate segments listed, each with a disposition row
Final segments inside the depth band
Every segment carries Status, Market, Justification, factors, Scene, Observable difference, Cost of failure
Segments name concrete situations and actors, not demographics
Scene is a present-tense scene, not a category description
3 to 7 styles, inside the depth band
Every style carries table, warrant, description, context, differentiation, 3/2/2 jobs
Styles are incompatible ways of thinking, not one person relabeled; near-merges are named
Rewritten, Contextual and Higher sections present
Every contextual candidate carries a T result naming a test or pass
Contextual jobs inside the depth band, with the failures accounted for
No adjectives, adverbs or conjunctions; the solution is context, not object
Direct, Indirect, Hidden and Key insights present
Each competitor section holds 3+ entries
Every named brand carries verificado or candidato
Every entry names the step it serves or states that it serves none
Hidden competitors are workarounds, not market leaders restated
The role table has the fixed columns: Role, Status, Actor, Market, Warrant
All twelve roles present, in order, each with a status
Every populated role carries a fragment containing the role's action
Every Not applicable carries a scope reason; every Same actor names the role
Actors are role classes in plural, never invented people, titles or emoji
At most three Hypothesis entries, each with a disconfirming check
All five categories present
Every factor carries a variable and a concrete example
Exactly three ranked factors, each with a reason
Variables describe observable situations, not demographics or truisms
The depth's number of criteria, each under its own heading
Every criterion carries Justification, Score with Basis, Metrics and Current alternative
The summary table holds one rewritten variant per criterion
Metrics name observable measurements across speed, ease and consistency
Raw criteria holds the depth's raw count
Top criteria holds 5/10/20 by depth
Every top criterion carries Justification, Score with Basis, Metrics and Current alternative
Criteria quantify money, time or risk exposure, not comfort words
Every discarded criterion has a disposition row
Every job row names the step it belongs to
One emotional and one social job per anchored step, by depth
Every row carries an observable signal
No opposing pair claims the same outcome; statements follow the rules
Both ends stated with a status, or Open with what would settle it
The step table has the fixed columns: Step, Phase, Executor, Decider, Output, Failure mode, Status
Step count inside the depth band, or an explicit override
Every step carries phase, executor, decider, output, failure mode and status
The decider column names a role class or Open; no unknown approver is left blank
The last step is the job's completed outcome, with corrections modelled as a loop
The riskiest steps carry a metric with type, measurement and source
All six phases appear in the coverage table, with zero-step phases justified
No step exists only to populate a phase; each step is an action the actor takes
No step opens with manage, facilitate, empower, enable, ensure or oversee
The five timeline stages present, each with a Status
Push, Pull, Anxiety and Habit each carry at least one statused entry
Quotes are verbatim or absent; no quote is reconstructed from a persona
